set.body:
Objective
Lock source revision, small independent fixtures and output contracts before replacing orchestration. Preserve useful fixtures while removing obsolete API-shaped test scaffolding later.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PRED-01, REL-01, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
qualification; ClassificationSuite, MvpaParityFixtures, OperatorRsaSuite, OneShotMvpa tests; docs/scenarios. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M0.01. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. SwiftCentroidClassifier uses its training-fitted Z-score once; freeze class order, priors, scores, probabilities, predictions and pooled-sample denominators.
2. Freeze identity-metric all-distinct ordered-partition signed squared-Euclidean RDM behavior and optional feature-count normalization; do not relabel it estimated-noise crossnobis.
3. Use independently computed dense/reference expectations, not a second call through the implementation helper.
4. Record tolerances, conditioning, failure policy and JVM/JS receipts; historical passing logs alone are insufficient.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaFitJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaFitJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M0.04: Freeze independent migration parity fixtures and baseline conventions
